annotations.title: Yesterday to today at one shop

description: Price movements at one supermarket between the latest nightly snapshot and the previous one: shelf price rises and falls with old price, new price and % change, and promotions starting or ending listed separately (an offer ending is not a price rise). It covers those two snapshots only. The lists' _total fields say how many changed in all. Each product returned costs one credit.

limit.description: How many products to return in each list (default 25, at most 200).

store.description: The shop: aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl.

name: recent_price_changes

left.description: Credits left on the account after it
left.title: Left

note.description: Said when the balance is low, or when it cut this answer short
note.title: Note

used.description: Credits this answer cost: one for each record it returned
used.title: Used

outputSchema.description:
The /changes payload.

Shelf moves, promotions and loyalty-card changes are deliberately SEPARATE
buckets, not one blended list: an expiring offer is not a price rise, and
merging them turns a price report into a promotions calendar.

clubcard_changes.description: Member price changes: Tesco Clubcard, SuperValu Real Rewards or Lidl Plus
clubcard_changes.title: Clubcard Changes

credits.description: What this answer cost the person's BasketWatch account and what is left. Missing on a free answer
